meaning: A NUMERICAL REFERENCE, NOT A MEASURED PRODUCTION REJECTION RATE OR PERMISSION FOR A LIVE GATE (the item 5). The corrected calibration (record version arm_fit_calibration_v3, potential precise_turn_v1, arm_pose_fit.py at commit fdbc24bdf9bc4d546696fc6a9a9ec57b6d2d35e5) on the same recorded pose selection as the refused run of Oct 23 (Tests row arm_fit_calibration_check). A floor fit starts at its pose's known answer (the recorded hinge angles), so its residual measures the fit's numerical floor (float32 storage of the pose and the solver's stopping), not the reliability of a fit from the live initial guess. Every fit continues from its first polish's angles on the precise potential, is read at its judged point (the continuation's end point when kept, else the first polish's angles) and is stationary only when the precise potential's bound-aware projected gradient there is at or under 1e-10 rad. The calibration's own locality fits (from the reference configuration, then the middle of the ranges when the first ends above a line) are reported beside it. A record the pass line refuses is reported as refused, with every check's value; nothing is relaxed.

selection.rule: up to 100 distinct legal samples per arm (7 recorded hinge angles inside the compiled ranges, no repeated set per arm), records in the spread sequence (golden-ratio sequence within each body, bodies in turn); a record is taken when each arm's sample is new, it brings a legal sample to an arm under the cap and puts no arm past it; past-range samples ride along

locality.start: the reference configuration, then the middle of the ranges when the first fit is above a line: the two-start rule of a gate without measured angles
locality.in_sample: the same poses whose floor residuals set the lines: an "above" here is a fit that ended elsewhere than its floor fit (another branch, or the same branch stopped apart), never an exceedance of the 1 / (n + 1) kind on a new pose; with the p99 statistic 1 in 100 inside poses also reads above its line by construction

record.meaning: version 3 (potential precise_turn_v1): every fit continues from the first polish's angles on the precise potential and is judged at its judged point (the continuation's end point when it was kept, else the first polish's angles). floor: per arm handle the residual at the judged point of the fit started at the recorded angles on poses whose hinges were all recorded inside their ranges, position cm (0 = the rebuilt part on the measured one) and rotation degrees (0 = the same orientation); tolerances: the statistic of those residuals; per_handle_first_polish: the same at the first polish's angles; per_handle_change: the size of the change from the first polish's residual to the judged point's (cm and degrees); angle_recovery_rad: the largest hinge difference between the judged point and the recorded angles (0 = the same configuration); past_range_allowance: the same residuals on poses recorded with a hinge past its range, kept out of the tolerances; locality: measured poses called above tolerance when fitted from the reference configuration alone and under the two-start rule (in sample); coverage: each hinge's recorded span, every recorded angle counted, as a share of its range (0 = one angle, 1 = the width of the whole range; above 1 when recorded angles lie past the range), a reading with no line; floor.fits: every floor fit's readings: stationary by the corrected reading (the precise potential's bound-aware projected gradient at the judged point at or under 1e-10 rad; a settled flow, an optimizer's success, an ftol end or a small residual is not stationarity) and its outcome (stationary, numerical_precision_failure or unfinished_optimization), stationary_v2_rule (the flow settled, or the module potential's projected gradient at the first polish's angles at or under 1e-10 rad: the rule of the version 2 records, a reading), the first polish's own end (polish_end: gtol, ftol, iteration_or_evaluation_limit, other or raised) and the continuation's (continuation_end: the same five, time_limit, evaluation_limit, numerical_precision_failure or not_started); not_stationary: the floor fits not stationary by the corrected reading (the pass line reads it); not_stationary_v2_rule: those not stationary by the v2 rule (a reading); polish_ends, continuation_ends, stationarity_outcomes, judged_points: counts per arm, inside and past-range poses apart
